name: footbal-predictions
description: World Cup 2026 score-prediction tracker — static dashboard + per-matchday reports published to GitHub Pages

scripts.build-site: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp dashboard.html dist/index.html && cp methodology.html dist/ && cp -r reports dist/ && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.publish-gh-pages: npm run build-site && gh-pages -d dist -e footbal --add --dotfiles -m "deploy footbal"
